basic_info.description: 2341 Chestnut Street is a 24-unit building in San Francisco's highly desirable Marina district. This prime location is situated on vibrant Chestnut Street at the heart of the all the best the Marina has to offer. The property is a mix of 9 one-bedroom and 15 studio apartments, including 3 ADU studios. This is a turn-key asset in one of San Francisco's most desirable locations, steps from the Marina Green, Palace of Fine Arts, and the vibrant Chestnut Street restaurant and shopping scene.
